environment.description: Staging analytics service on same EKS cluster (us-east-1), identical container image. LaunchDarkly SDK initialized with SDK key 'sdk-stag-analytics-3b9e'. The flag 'analytics.legacy-redirect-mode' uses a percentage rollout targeting rule where the context attribute 'environment' is evaluated: when environment='staging', the flag resolves to the OFF variation (false) with a fallthrough of false. The targeting rule was last modified 2024-01-15 and has prerequisite flag 'analytics.enable-legacy-features' which is itself OFF in staging. Note: the service still processes the request parameters and constructs header objects regardless of flag state - the flag only controls whether unsanitized values reach the response headers. Spring Boot actuator endpoint /manage/flags confirms current evaluation. Split.io telemetry sidecar also present but only for metrics collection, not enforcement.

config.launchdarkly_targeting_rule: environment=staging -> variation OFF; prerequisite: analytics.enable-legacy-features must be ON
